title: Trip Splash
desc: An orange dot swallows your logo, then a circle opens up your first screen.
long: Your logo appears and an orange dot eats its letters one by one. The dot then stretches into a streak that zips across the screen, and a big circle sweeps in from the left to open up your first screen. Hand it your own screen to show, or leave it empty to see a plain placeholder. The circle only uncovers your screen instead of redrawing it, so it stays light on the phone.
spec: Each letter follows its own keyframe track and shrinks toward the dot; the dot is drawn on top so they look swallowed.
The dot stretches into a streak whose head runs to the right edge, then the tail catches up and the streak fades.
A circle of almost constant radius slides in from the left edge with a fast ease-out, so the corners are the last thing revealed.
Tap anywhere to replay. The clock stops when the animation is over.
